info.name: Smart Campus Access Control System - Complete API Collection
info.description: Postman Collection covering 100% of the distributed microservices architecture (API Gateway, Registration, Authentication, Room Management, Permission Control, Load-Balanced Access Logging, Emergency Alerts, Student Microservice, and Teacher Microservice). Includes automated token extraction, RBAC negative testing, classroom enrollment, and diagnostic endpoints.
